name: enrol
description: Point every attached device's runner at a collector, without anybody typing an address.

url.description: The collector address to enrol devices onto. Omitted means the collector this executor is claiming from, which is almost always what you want.

device_id_prefix.description: Give each device an id of `<prefix>-<target id>` instead of letting the runner choose. Rarely wanted: a runner's own id is stable across reinstalls and this is not.

wait_s.description: How long to wait for each device to appear in the registry before calling the enrolment failed. Default 90.
